description: Four images discovered via isomorphismes.tumblr.com; only verified-license external image URLs can be loaded directly.
provenance_policy: Never assume an artwork is freely reusable because it is on Tumblr. Keep artist, title, archive post, license and export credit attached to any transformed image.

images.title: Untitled color study
images.use: Color without structure; freeze any frame before imposing symmetry.
Soft shapes and watercolor-like forms give a second, mathematical color source.
images.note: The Tumblr reblog spells the surname Tammett; the artist's own site spells it Tammet.

images.title: Blue Flare
images.use: Dense, sharply colored marks test reflections against preexisting visual structure.

images.title: In Angel's Care
images.use: Sparse linework gives obvious recognizable features after each reflection.
images.credit: In Angel's Care (1931): Paul Klee. Image: Solomon R. Guggenheim Foundation / Wikimedia Commons (CC0).
